main_text.p: Septem sunt, quæ frequenter præ oculis ha-bere debemus.
main_text.head: Primum:

Tertium:

Septimum:

p.bl: Es sind sieben dinge / die wir offt vor augen haben sollen.
Die mannigfaltigkeit unser Sünden / die wir begangen haben.

page.notes: Red ink underlining and strokes under several Latin lines (e.g. "vitæ brevitas", "nostræ incertitudo", "amaritudo", "privatio") and small pen marks are reader's markings, not print, and are omitted. The German text is set entirely in black letter; the Latin is roman with italics. The printed "vnser" is read as "unser" under the u/v rule. Labels such as "Primum:" are treated as level 3 headings because they are set apart, centred and italic.
